note: Genomic-context re-ranking and calling, scripts/46_context_rerank.py, for the CURRENT models (evidence-only endolysin, signal-filtered spanin). z_c(i) = logit(P_c(i)) + beta * max over neighbours j within W genes (j != i) of max over other classes c' of P_c'(j). beta and W chosen on the 130-genome CPT-curated benchmark. 5-fold cross-validated, genes ranked first without -> with context: holin 0.538 -> 0.603 (novel) / 0.705 -> 0.782 (known); endolysin 0.664 -> 0.720 / 0.848 -> 0.864; spanin best-per-genome 0.711 -> 0.733 / 0.844 -> 0.844, top 5 novel 0.914. A class's top context-ranked protein is CONFIDENT when z >= call_z (or, with --domains, when it carries a catalytic/family-defining lysis domain), else CANDIDATE. Out-of-fold precision / recall of confident calls, known | novel family: endolysin 0.94/0.86 | 0.82/0.61; holin 0.89/0.62 | 0.83/0.31; spanin 1.00/0.80 | 0.86/0.42. Precision is against CPT curation.
